announcements.headline: EQS-News: Results of Extraordinary General Meeting
announcements.insight: The Extraordinary General Meeting results follow the September notice. A dividend declaration was also made in October.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Dividend Declaration
announcements.insight: A dividend declaration follows the September notice of a general meeting. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for payment details.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: JPMorgan ETFs (Ireland) ICAV: Notice of GM
